lyric:
Before the first count of days,
God brought heaven and earth into being.
original: In the beginning God made the heaven and the earth.
But the earth was unsightly and unfurnished, and darkness was over the deep, and the Spirit of God moved over the water.

lyric:
Then God called, ‘Light, come forth!’
Brightness answered.
original: And God said, Let there be light, and there was light.

lyric:
He looked on the light: good.
He cut a clear line between it and darkness.
original: And God saw the light that it was good, and God divided between the light and the darkness.
And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night, and there was evening and there was morning, the first day.

lyric:
God spoke: ‘A firmament amid the waters!
Let water part from water!’
His word took hold.
original: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the water, and let it be a division between water and water, and it was so.
And God made the firmament, and God divided between the water which was under the firmament and the water which was above the firmament.

lyric:
He called the firmament Heaven.
He looked on it: good.
Dusk. Dawn. The second day.
original: And God called the firmament Heaven, and God saw that it was good, and there was evening and there was morning, the second day.

And God said, Let the water which is under the heaven be collected into one place, and let the dry land appear, and it was so. And the water which was under the heaven was collected into its places, and the dry land appeared.

lyric:
He named the dry ground Earth,
the gathered waters Seas.
He looked on them: good.
original: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gatherings of the waters he called Seas, and God saw that it was good.

lyric:
‘Ground, send up seed-bearing grass
in kind and likeness!
Trees, bear fruit with seed within,
each true to its kind!’
His word took hold.
original: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the herb of grass bearing seed according to its kind and according to its likeness, and the fruit-tree bearing fruit whose seed is in it, according to its kind on the earth, and it was so.

lyric:
Green surged from the soil:
grass with seed in its kind and likeness;
fruit wrapped around its seed,
tree by tree, kind by kind.
He looked on it: good.
original: And the earth brought forth the herb of grass bearing seed according to its kind and according to its likeness, and the fruit tree bearing fruit whose seed is in it, according to its kind on the earth, and God saw that it was good.

lyric: Dusk. Dawn. The third day.
original: And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.
And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth, to divide between day and night, and let them be for signs and for seasons and for days and for years.

lyric:
‘From that height, shine on the earth!’
His word took hold.
original: And let them be for light in the firmament of the heaven, so as to shine upon the earth, and it was so.

lyric:
Two great lights He fashioned:
the greater to command the day,
the lesser to command the night.
He made the stars as well.
original: And God made the two great lights, the greater light for regulating the day and the lesser light for regulating the night, the stars also.

lyric:
He set them in Heaven’s span
to send their light across the earth,
original: And God placed them in the firmament of the heaven, so as to shine upon the earth,

lyric:
to rule night and day,
to keep the bright apart from dark.
He looked on them: good.
original: and to regulate day and night, and to divide between the light and the darkness. And God saw that it was good.

lyric: Dusk. Dawn. The fourth day.
original: And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.

lyric:
‘Water, swarm with living reptiles!
Winged creatures, fly above the earth
across Heaven’s firmament!’
His word took hold.
original: And God said, Let the waters bring forth reptiles having life, and winged creatures flying above the earth in the firmament of heaven, and it was so.

lyric:
God made the great whales,
every living water-reptile by kind,
and every winged creature by kind.
He looked on them: good.
original: And God made great whales, and every living reptile, which the waters brought forth according to their kinds, and every creature that flies with wings according to its kind, and God saw that they were good.

lyric:
His blessing rang out:
‘Increase! Multiply! Fill the seas!
Let the winged multiply on earth!’
original: And God blessed them, saying, Increase and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let the creatures that fly be multiplied on the earth.

lyric: Dusk. Dawn. The fifth day.
original: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.

lyric:
‘Earth, bring out living kinds:
four-footed beasts, crawling reptiles,
wild beasts, each after its kind!’
His word took hold.
original: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature according to its kind, quadrupeds and reptiles and wild beasts of the earth according to their kind, and it was so.

lyric:
He fashioned wild beasts, cattle,
and the reptiles of the ground,
each after its kind.
He looked on them: good.
original: And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to their kind, and cattle according to their kind, and all the reptiles of the earth according to their kind, and God saw that they were good.

And God said, Let us make man according to our image and likeness, and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the flying creatures of heaven, and over the cattle and all the earth, and over all the reptiles that creep on the earth.

lyric:
God made humankind in His own image;
male and female He made them.
original: And God made man, according to the image of God he made him, male and female he made them.

lyric:
He blessed them:
‘Increase! Multiply! Fill the earth;
bring it under your rule!
Govern fish and birds and cattle,
all the earth and all that crawls!’
original: And God blessed them, saying, Increase and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it, and have dominion over the fish of the seas and flying creatures of heaven, and all the cattle and all the earth, and all the reptiles that creep on the earth.

lyric:
He gave them every seed-bearing herb
across the earth,
and every tree whose fruit holds seed:
food for humankind.
original: And God said, Behold I have given to you every seed-bearing herb sowing seed which is upon all the earth, and every tree which has in itself the fruit of seed that is sown, to you it shall be for food.

lyric:
For wild beasts, flying creatures,
and all the reptiles of the earth
that carry the breath of life,
He gave every green plant for food.
His word took hold.
original: And to all the wild beasts of the earth, and to all the flying creatures of heaven, and to every reptile creeping on the earth, which has in itself the breath of life, even every green plant for food; and it was so.

lyric:
God looked upon all He had made:
the whole of it, very good.
Dusk. Dawn. The sixth day.
original: And God saw all the things that he had made, and, behold, they were very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
